RustyShelf 0.6.7 hides a game in one key, puts the games you own but haven't installed on the PC shelf, can stay off the Internet, and brings over much of [MicaelTek](https://github.com/MicaelTek)'s work on PC games from their fork of Boxshelf.

## New

- **Hide in one key.** On the shelf, X hides the chosen game and U within five seconds puts it back. On a pad, hold X to hide; a tap of X just after puts it back, and otherwise opens Details as before.
- **Internet access.** Settings → System → Internet access is on by default. Switched off, RustyShelf reaches nothing on the Internet: no box art, game info, achievements, manuals, downloads or update checks. A RomM server on your home network, the phone companion, Game streaming and Discord keep working. Games and their stores still go online on their own.
- **Privacy.** [PRIVACY.md](https://github.com/zearkreast/rustyshelf/blob/rustyshelf/PRIVACY.md) lists what stays on your computer and every site RustyShelf asks, what it sends and when.
- **Games you haven't installed.** Settings → PC → Games you haven't installed (Windows, off by default) puts every game your Playnite store libraries own but that isn't installed on the PC shelf, greyed. Install opens Steam's own install for a Steam game and Playnite for the rest.
- **Edit a shelf.** Settings → Games → Edit a shelf lists every game of a shelf, A to Z, with Find a game; left or right puts each on the shelf, among the favorites or hidden, at once.
- **IGDB for PC games.** With the IGDB keys, a PC game's description, genres, developer and dates come from IGDB too. Details → IGDB match searches IGDB and keeps the game you pick; Details → Edit details takes the description, developer, publisher, genres and year you type, over every source. Both work for console games as well.
- **Every PC cover at once.** Settings → PC → Download missing PC covers finds the best front cover for each PC game without one (Steam's own, Steam's store, or SteamGridDB's posters with the key), with its progress and a Cancel. Refresh all PC covers looks again at every one, and Undo puts back what the last run replaced.
- **Import collections.** Settings → Collections imports Steam's collections and (Windows) Playnite's categories as shelves of your own; Steam's Favorites join your favorites, and importing again brings them up to date. Steam and Playnite are only read.
- **PC game manuals.** Details → Read manual opens a PC game's manual like a console game's: one you gave it, the PDF that came in its folder, or the manual Steam keeps for a Steam game.

## Changed

- **Power** in the quick menu opens into four even tiles with their signs. Restart PC and Shut down turn warm when chosen, as they can't be taken back.
- **A PC game's launcher.** With Seamless play, a game started from its own program (GOG's, Quiver's, the PC games folder's, one added by hand) is followed through its folder, so a launcher that starts the game and closes no longer brings the shelf back early, and the playtime counts the game.

Quick hide, games you haven't installed, Edit a shelf, IGDB for PC games, the launcher watch, bulk covers and the collection import are ported from [MicaelTek's boxshelf-source](https://github.com/MicaelTek/boxshelf-source). Thank you!

## Download

| | File | |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows** | `RustyShelf-0.6.7-windows-setup.exe` | The installer. |
| | `RustyShelf-0.6.7-windows.zip` | The app and its `data` folder, to unzip anywhere. `--windowed` starts it in a window. |
| **Linux** | `RustyShelf-0.6.7-linux.AppImage` | `chmod +x` it once, then start it. |
| **Android** | `RustyShelf-0.6.7-android.apk` | arm64. Installs over 0.6.x. |

`SHA256SUMS.txt` has each file's SHA-256 sum.

The manual lists [everything that works](https://github.com/zearkreast/rustyshelf/blob/rustyshelf/docs/MANUAL.md#what-works). Found a problem? [Open an issue](https://github.com/zearkreast/rustyshelf/issues).
